flows.observation: Layer definitions, authored requirement/criterion graph and mappings save through fresh DI scopes. Active-layer selection mutates host WorkspaceEntity. Batch add is idempotent for already-visible records; individual create can revive a tombstone and resets creation time. Update replaces dependent AC rows. Mapping replacement tombstones missing links and revives selected links. Compensation preserves scoped identities, criteria and shadow delete state.
flows.boundary: Keep definitions/criteria/links in owning authored project operation, selector operational. Preserve standalone behavior, exact composite keys, provenance and existing retired-ID policy. Bootstrap, restoration, fresh scopes, batches and compensation must retain original project/branch. Native provider must prove actual dependent-row replacement, soft-delete/filter and transaction behavior; syntax save count is insufficient.

flows.boundary: Retain original LocalOperational classification even for explicit CRUD. Raw/derived storage must not dirty project working set or acquire federation edit lease. flows.observation: Website streaming upserts each fetched document/chunk set, emits persisted progress, then saves the context. Helper replaces existing chunks, updates/replaces raw documents, and attempts embeddings/vector updates with caught per-chunk errors.
flows.boundary: Raw ingestion remains operational; progress messages and successful helper returns alone do not establish durable rows. Prove exact operational rows and vector/rebuild state at save/failure/reopen while authored content, head, branch and lease remain unchanged.

Preserve survivor/victim lineage and all original rows under migration; pending native ownership/recovery proofs.
